title: $20B AI Hedge Fund Chases Fresh Cash After June Tech Rout
author: Eastern-Apartment934
selftext: The $225M seed-fueled AI-focused fund that delivered 439% returns YTD faced steep losses in the late June AI selloff, now seeking new capital amid market jitters. Bulls see this pullback as a healthy reset, while bears warn of dot-com-like circular funding risks. Are you still bullish on the AI supercycle long-term?
